Caption: "Figure 1: The prices of two assets". The prose names London Bullion Market Association for gold and NASDAQ for bitcoin; neither source is printed on the figure. The sentence before the figure prints "bitcoin.The" with no space after the period.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The figure shows two price paths over the stated window. It shows no forecast and no trade.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: Axis readings are eye estimates. No model output on the figure.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Give the whole route in one diagram before any section starts.
visualization_observations.summary: A block diagram captioned only "Figure 2: Overall structure", with no sentence explaining it. The boxes split the strategy into a "Conservative strategy" and a "Risk strategy", two branches. The prose everywhere else uses three trader types. No numbers, no dates, no fees on the diagram.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Show one cycle of forecast against the realized price.
visualization_observations.summary: Caption "Figure 5: Forecast charts in one cycle". One cycle is the three-day test window described in the prose. No axis unit beyond what is drawn.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The chart shows a forecast and a realized path for one cycle. It does not show the decision coefficient.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: Cycle dates are not printed on the figure. Readings are eye estimates.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Draw the decision of whether to trade at all.
visualization_observations.summary: A flowchart captioned "Figure 6: The process of determining whether to trade". Left diamond prints "X_{g(i+1)} - Y_{gi} > 0": the forecast is subscripted g(i+1) and the realized price is subscripted gi with no parentheses. The yes branch computes the increase threshold e_{g(i+1)}; the no branch computes the decrease threshold f_{g(i+1)}. A second diamond prints "X_{g(i+1)} - Y_{gi} > e_{g(i+1)}". The cash test prints "q_i > q", yes leading to an orange box "go to step 4(1)", no leading to a blue box "i=i+1 back to step2". The lower diamond prints "|X_g - Y_g| > f_{g(i+1)}" with the subscripts reduced to g, yes leading to an orange box "go to step 4(2)". The prose above says the figure avoids frequent trading and avoids too little cash. Equations (10), (11) and (12) are printed below the caption and are not part of the figure.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The chart shows a two-threshold test plus a cash test, with two exits into step 4 and one loop back. It does not show a trade quantity.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: The subscripts on the diamonds do not match equation (6): i+1 against gi, and bare g. Both are printed; neither was corrected.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Draw how many units to trade once a trade is allowed.
visualization_observations.summary: A flowchart captioned "Figure 7: The process of determining the number of transactions". A yellow box "(1) calculate decision coefficient" feeds a diamond that prints "R^i < R^i", the same quantity on both sides, so the test is always true or always false as drawn. The yes branch says "purchase with W_{Hg} proportion", the no branch "purchase with W_{Lg} proportion". An orange box "(2) purchase with m_g proportion" joins both branches into "Calculate the asset distribution and total assets after the transaction", then a diamond "i>n" with yes to "end" and no to "i=i+1 back to step2". Equation (13) is printed below the caption and is not part of the figure. The prose above says the smaller the coefficient, the more stable the model.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The chart shows a split on the decision coefficient into a high and a low purchase share, plus a separate sale share. The split condition as printed compares a quantity with itself.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: No value for either share. The diamond contradicts itself; kept as printed.

visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: No marker at the endpoint. The dollar figure lives in the prose.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Restate the strategy as three questions inside the memorandum.

The memo's own headings are "When to trade", "Deal what", "How much is the deal". The figure and the memo ask the same three questions in different words.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Show the common-type trader's holdings in the appendix.
visualization_observations.summary: Three panels captioned "Figure 17: Changes of various assets of common-type traders", drawn in red. (a) cash in dollars, axis to 4000, with a spike near 2018 above 4000 and a plateau near 2700 through 2019 before settling near 1100. (b) gold in ounces, axis 0 to 1.0, rising to about 1.0 by 2018 and flat after. (c) bitcoin in pieces, axis 0 to 1.0, a step to about 0.35 in 2018 and another to just above 1.0 in 2019. Table 6 lists the common type as cash 421.14, gold 0.61, bitcoin 1.05. The gold and bitcoin axes can hold those numbers; the cash axis and the cash path do not end near 421.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The panels show the common-type paths. The cash path does not end where the table says.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: Endpoint readings are eye estimates. The table and the chart disagree on cash; both kept.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Show the radical-type trader's holdings in the appendix.
visualization_observations.summary: Three panels captioned "Figure 18: Changes of various assets of radical-type traders", drawn in blue. (a) cash falls from about 600 to near 0 at the very start and stays there. (b) gold sits just above 0.16 for the whole window. (c) bitcoin rises to about 2.8 at the start and stays flat. Table 6 lists the radical type as cash 22.31, gold 0.16, bitcoin 2.84, which agrees with these axes. The appendix title above the figures prints "Appendix A  Changes of Various Types of Traders' Assets"; the text layer's "Assetes" is an extraction error and is void.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The panels agree with the radical column of Table 6. The appendix title is spelled correctly on the page.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: The early jumps are eye readings. No exact endpoint is labeled.
